# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) — Direct Land & Plot Marketplace

> BhoomiMitra is India's direct-to-owner land and agricultural plot classifieds platform, facilitating direct connection between landowners and prospective buyers with 0% brokerage commissions, transparent document disclosure, interactive satellite maps, and a flat advertising fee model.

## Platform Summary
- **Website**: https://bhoomimitra.com
- **Operating Model**: Direct peer-to-peer classifieds marketplace.
- **Target Audience**: Indian landowners, agricultural buyers, residential plot buyers, and commercial land investors.
- **Geographic Coverage**: Pan-India across all 28 states and 8 union territories.
- **Core Value Proposition**: 0% Broker Commission, Direct landowner listings, Transparent seller-provided document disclosure, Direct Phone inquiry contact, and Interactive Google Satellite property boundary viewing.
- **Legal Advisory**: BhoomiMitra does not provide title verification, legal certification, or government survey verification. All listings are seller-provided. Prospective buyers are advised to independently conduct due diligence (inspecting 30-year deed chains, EC Form 15, Pahani/7-12 extracts, and revenue survey sketches) with independent legal counsel before transacting.

## Indian Land Measurement Conversions
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)

## Key Public Routes
- `/`: Marketplace homepage with multi-attribute search and featured land classifieds.
- `/buy`: Interactive land explorer with price sliders, unit conversions, and location filters.
- `/sell`: Multi-step land listing creator with seller legal declarations and instant publishing upon payment.
- `/pricing`: Platform advertising pricing (Flat ₹10-₹25 for 30-day listing subscriptions).
- `/about`: BhoomiMitra mission, transparency policies, and zero-brokerage classifieds model.
- `/contact`: Customer support desk and listing grievance redressal team.
- `/listing-rules`: Standards for seller submissions, legal declarations, and prohibited listings.
- `/properties/[id]`: Dedicated property details page featuring satellite map views, road width, facing direction, seller-provided documents, Land Buyer's Due Diligence Checklist, and "Call Seller" action.
